FortiGate IPsec VPN Security Audit
================================================================================

─── Overview ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Phase1 tunnels: 1  Phase2 SAs: 1

─── Phase1: vpn-to-branch ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+-----------------------------------------------------------+
| Tunnel Name            | vpn-to-branch                    |
| IKE Version            | 1                                |
| Mode                   | aggressive                       |
| Auth Method            | psk                              |
| Proposal               | 3des-md5                         |
| DH Groups              | 1 2                              |
| DPD                    | disable                          |
| Rekey                  | disable                          |
| Key Lifetime           | 172800                           |
| NAT Traversal          |                                  |
+-----------------------------------------------------------+
Findings:
  [MEDIUM] VPN 'vpn-to-branch': IKEv1 — upgrade to IKEv2 (RFC 7296) for improved security.
  [HIGH] VPN 'vpn-to-branch': IKEv1 aggressive mode — PSK hash sent in cleartext, offline cracking possible.
  [HIGH] VPN 'vpn-to-branch': weak algorithm 'DES' in IKE proposal — use AES256/SHA256+.
  [HIGH] VPN 'vpn-to-branch': weak algorithm '3DES' in IKE proposal — use AES256/SHA256+.
  [HIGH] VPN 'vpn-to-branch': weak algorithm 'MD5' in IKE proposal — use AES256/SHA256+.
  [HIGH] VPN 'vpn-to-branch': DH group 1 is below 2048-bit.
  [HIGH] VPN 'vpn-to-branch': DH group 2 is below 2048-bit.
  [MEDIUM] VPN 'vpn-to-branch': PSK authentication — certificate-based auth is stronger.
  [HIGH] VPN 'vpn-to-branch': PSK appears short (<20 chars) — use 32+ random characters.
  [INFO] VPN 'vpn-to-branch': Dead Peer Detection disabled — stale tunnels persist.
  [MEDIUM] VPN 'vpn-to-branch': rekey disabled — long-lived session keys reduce forward secrecy.
  [MEDIUM] VPN 'vpn-to-branch': IKE key lifetime 172800s exceeds 24h — reduce to 8h or less.

─── Phase2: vpn-to-branch-p2 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
+-----------------------------------------------------------+
| SA Name                | vpn-to-branch-p2                 |
| Phase1                 | vpn-to-branch                    |
| Proposal               | 3des-md5                         |
| PFS                    | disable                          |
| DH Group               |                                  |
| Key Lifetime           | 172800                           |
| Anti-Replay            |                                  |
+-----------------------------------------------------------+
Findings:
  [HIGH] Phase2 'vpn-to-branch-p2': weak algorithm 'DES' in ESP proposal.
  [HIGH] Phase2 'vpn-to-branch-p2': weak algorithm '3DES' in ESP proposal.
  [HIGH] Phase2 'vpn-to-branch-p2': weak algorithm 'MD5' in ESP proposal.
  [HIGH] Phase2 'vpn-to-branch-p2': PFS disabled — session key compromise exposes all past sessions.
  [MEDIUM] Phase2 'vpn-to-branch-p2': key lifetime 172800s exceeds 8h — shorter rekey recommended.
